regressions.baseline: 7 tests, 13 assertions, 6 failures for new account/reset subject, heading and additional content; order case passed.
regressions.after: 9 unit tests, 22 assertions; 45 integration tests, 99 assertions; all passed.

restoration: Original email settings, translations and recipient locale restored through saved fixture backup.
evidenceHandling: Only translation markers and confirmation paths retained. Reset keys, addresses, credentials, email bodies and session material omitted.
limits: Browser workflow exercised reset mail. New account fields and order compatibility covered by WordPress/Polylang integration regressions.
Complete translated WooCommerce catalogs and remaining email type matrix still pending.
